theme.style: An archivist's light table: graphite and charcoal surfaces washed with warm amber lamp glow, as if a desk lamp is raking across a dark studio. Paper-white and cream tones appear as calm counterpoints midway through the deck, giving rhythm between dark trust slides and bright clarity slides. Textures are subtle — fine paper grain, soft volumetric light, matte metal — never glossy or neon. A single deliberate deep-teal shift late in the deck signals the smart, on-device intelligence.
